name: Ace Office Pods frequently asked questions

questions.question: What is included in the office pod price?
questions.answer: Our office pod price typically includes the pod unit, built-in lighting, ventilation, power access, and model-specific table or seating setup. Delivery and installation within Klang Valley are included under the agreed project scope. We confirm inclusions clearly before final confirmation.

questions.question: What affects the final office pod price?
questions.answer: Final pricing depends on pod size, model type, quantity, custom options, and site access conditions. For example, lift access, staircase handling, and installation complexity can affect project cost. These factors are reviewed early so pricing is clear before commitment.

questions.question: Which office pod is suitable for calls, focused work, or meetings?
questions.answer: Ace Solo and Ace Plus are best for private calls, video meetings, and focused individual work. Ace Flex is suitable for one-to-one discussions, while Ace Meet and Ace Hub are built for team meetings and collaboration. We recommend based on your real daily usage and team flow.

questions.question: How soundproof are office pods in real working environments?
questions.answer: Our office pods achieve an independently certified −27 dB(A) noise reduction. This significantly reduces surrounding noise for calls and meetings. They are highly effective for privacy, although no pod is completely 100% soundproof.

questions.question: What happens if we need help after delivery?
questions.answer: After delivery, our team can support follow-up adjustments, servicing needs, and practical usage guidance based on the agreed support scope. You will have a clear contact path for post-installation support. This helps keep the pod reliable for daily operation.

questions.question: Are office pods better than building new rooms?
questions.answer: For many workplaces, office pods are a faster and less disruptive way to add private space for calls, focused work, and meetings. They can also be relocated if your office layout changes. For fully permanent structural needs, building new rooms may still be the better fit.

questions.question: Are Ace Office Pods made in Malaysia?
questions.answer: Yes. All Ace Office Pods are manufactured in Selangor, Malaysia. You can visit our factory showroom to inspect build quality and test soundproofing before placing an order. Local manufacturing also means local support — the same team handles production, installation, and post-installation servicing.

questions.question: What does 27 dBA noise reduction actually mean?
questions.answer: A typical open office has around 60–65 dB of background noise. With 27 dBA reduction, the level inside the pod drops to approximately 35–38 dB — similar to a quiet library. In practical terms, someone standing two desks away cannot make out your words. The 27 dBA rating applies to Ace Plus, Ace Flex, Ace Flex Duo, Ace Meet, and Ace Hub.
